title: Seattle-based StepSecurity, which offers a software supply chain security platform, raised a $20M Series A led by Elephant, bringing its total funding to $23M (Chris Metinko/Axios)
summary: Chris Metinko / Axios: Seattle-based StepSecurity, which offers a software supply chain security platform, raised a $20M Series A led by Elephant, bringing its total funding to $23M — Cybersecurity startup StepSecurity raised a $20 million Series A led by Elephant, co-founders Varun Sharma and Ashish Kurmi tell Axios Pro exclusively.
